package.description: Turns a folder of photographs into a vertical video edit cut to a beat grid.

en-GB.description: Turns a folder of photographs into a vertical video edit cut to a beat grid.
en-GB.longDescription: ReelGeek builds a real edit rather than a slideshow. It reads photographs from a folder, cuts them against a tempo grid, gives every shot its own camera move and picks a transition to get out of it, then renders a 1080x1920 H.264 MP4 that uploads as it is to TikTok or YouTube Shorts. Everything is read from the disk and rendered on the processor, so nothing is uploaded anywhere, and there is no account, no watermark and no export limit.
en-GB.name: ReelGeek
